$comment: Entry schema for contributes.linters (process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_linters.go and linter_invoke.go. action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'. The host calls it through plugin_host_lint with {linter, languageId, fileName, relativePath? (only with workspace.read), text, trigger} (<= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms, {{limits.concurrentPerPlugin}} call per plugin) and expects {"diagnostics": [{startLineNumber, startColumn, endLineNumber, endColumn, severity?, message, code?, source?, tags?}]} (<= {{limits.diagnosticsMax}} items; 1-based lines <= {{limits.lineMax}}, columns <= {{limits.columnMax}}; message <= {{limits.messageMaxRunes}} characters and {{limits.messageMaxLines}} lines; code and source single lines <= {{limits.codeMaxRunes}} characters). Invalid diagnostics are dropped; diagnostics never carry links. Linters run only for languages whose machine-local preference selects them; 'type' runs debounced and only when the user also enabled lint-while-typing. Optional detect.files only lets the host ask the user once when a project uses the tool; optional enableSetting names a workspace-scoped boolean setting that the prompt also turns on.
description: Linters: show diagnostics for documents of the listed languages through one of this plugin's read actions.

items.description: Monaco language id, for example json, typescript or a language this plugin contributes.

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read'.

triggers.description: When the linter may run. Defaults to ["open", "save"].

debounceMs.description: Delay after the last edit for the 'type' trigger (default 750). Allowed only when triggers includes 'type'.

files.description: Project-relative files or directories (for example eslint.config.js or .github/workflows) whose presence at the project root or in one first-level subdirectory means the project uses this tool. The host then asks the user once whether to use the linter; detection never runs it.

enableSetting.description: Key of one of this plugin's contributes.configuration properties with type boolean and scope workspace that the tool needs because it runs project code. Accepting the host's prompt also turns it on for the current workspace.
